title.zh: AlphaFi Winds Down After Oracle Error, With Sui Foundation Support
title.en: AlphaFi Winds Down After Oracle Error, With Sui Foundation Support

current_state.zh: AlphaFi is winding down operations after an oracle error forced it to disable new deposits and loans, with the Sui Foundation supporting the process and Slush users instructed to immediately exit four affected strategies.
